anomalies.description: The woman appears to be concealing or transferring an item from a shelf into her bag while crouching and turning away from the camera—a behavior consistent with shoplifting. Her posture (bending, head down, avoiding direct line of sight) and repeated motion over several seconds indicate deliberate, covert action rather than normal browsing.

A person in a pink top and dark skirt is crouching beside stacked boxes, repeatedly reaching into or manipulating items on a low shelf or container, then appears to conceal or transfer items into a large dark bag placed between their legs. Their posture and repeated furtive movements suggest possible shoplifting—specifically concealing merchandise in a bag without paying. The behavior is inconsistent with normal browsing or restocking.
